markers.title: Idaho AG Labrador touts state’s Medicaid fraud recovery at D.C. roundtable with VP JD Vance
markers.what_we_found: Idaho Attorney General Raúl Labrador on Tuesday asked U.S. Vice President JD Vance and other top federal officials for broader access to Medicaid data to further fraud investigation and recovery.
markers.why_it_matters: Changes in local systems can shift how reliably households can access core services week to week.

regional_reports.title: ‘Light rail to nowhere’? Surging costs undercut I-5 bridge transit plan
regional_reports.what_we_found: A ginormous cost increase to construct a new bridge linking Washington and Oregon is forcing state leaders and program managers to rightsize public expectations for the megaproject. And, some say, downsize the vision for a marquee component — light rail.
regional_reports.why_it_matters: Transportation disruptions can limit work, school, and emergency access across connected communities.
regional_reports.read_more_label: ‘Light rail to nowhere’? Surging costs undercut I-5 bridge transit plan

regional_reports.title: Oregonians using SNAP benefits most frequently listed big grocery, retail companies as employer
regional_reports.what_we_found: Oregonians who received federal aid to pay for their groceries last year frequently reported working for the nation’s largest grocery and retail corporations, according to a Capital Chronicle analysis of Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program data from the Oregon Department of Human Services.
regional_reports.why_it_matters: Budget and staffing shifts can change the capacity of local agencies to deliver services.
regional_reports.read_more_label: Oregonians using SNAP benefits most frequently listed big grocery, retail companies as employer
